meeting_window.summary: 這是第一次會議，主要目標是設定和測試多聲道錄音設備。與會者（Morgan, Adam, Dan）花了大量時間進行麥克風檢查、執行「朗讀數字」任務以收集數據，並深入討論了設備的技術問題，包括機櫃、前置放大器噪聲、數據儲存空間（預估每小時1-2GB）以及後續處理流程。會議也規劃了未來的錄音方向，希望能納入更多不同主題的會議及女性參與者，並討論了語音轉寫的策略。
key_points: 首次測試多聲道錄音設置。
執行「朗讀數字」任務以收集語音數據。
討論了硬體（機櫃、前置放大器）、儲存（需要更多硬碟空間）和轉寫（內部處理 vs. 外部服務）等議題。
確定了後續需要處理數據和改善設備的行動項目。
open_questions: 如何最有效地解決前置放大器的噪聲問題？
應該採用內部還是外部服務進行大規模的語音轉寫？
最佳的長期數據儲存與管理策略是什麼？

meeting_window.summary: 本次會議的核心是規劃會議錄音的轉錄工作。團隊討論了轉錄的負責人、所需工具、資料格式，以及未來擴大規模時的人力與資源問題。最終決定先評估名為「Transcriber」的軟體工具，並指派了相關的行動項目。
key_points: 會議主軸是規劃與定義會議錄音的轉錄流程，以供後續訓練語音辨識模型使用。
與會者討論了轉錄工作的負責人，決定由 Jane (fe008) 負責初期的先導轉錄任務。
會議花費大量時間討論轉錄工具，最終鎖定法國國家資訊與自動化研究所(INRIA)開發的「Transcriber」作為首要評估對象。
團隊探討了大規模轉錄的可行方案，包括雇用大學生、預算成本與品質控管等問題。
會議決定轉錄的資料格式，將採用類似 STM 的格式，標記發言者與時間戳記以處理重疊對話。
open_questions: 最有效且最具成本效益的轉錄工具是什麼？
專案要如何資助與管理大規模轉錄所需的人力與資源？
遠場麥克風的語音辨識準確率，是否足以支援有用的資訊檢索功能？

meeting_window.summary: The team discussed the transcription process, corpus distribution, and room electronics. Key decisions included using students for transcription, investigating the CSAE corpus, and planning an experiment to optimize transcription workflow. Updates were also given on new hardware for microphone connections and equipment storage.
key_points: Decided to hire students for transcription instead of using expensive commercial services.
Eric (me022) will order the CSAE corpus for evaluation.
Jane (fe008) will consult with Liz on discourse transcription requirements.
An experiment will be run to test if pre-segmentation speeds up transcription.
Jim (me028) provided an update on the custom microphone jack boxes and will design a new equipment cabinet.
The team will set up a wireless laptop as a control/monitoring UI in the room.

action_items.title: 改善和簡化錄音設備設置流程
action_items.detail: 持續整理和優化錄音硬體設置，使其未來能更快速、更輕易地為會議準備就緒。
action_items.evidence: ...the continuing process of cleaning up the stuff and making it easier to do that.

action_items.title: 處理本次會議的錄音數據以供轉寫
action_items.detail: 將本次（Bmr001）的多聲道錄音檔進行處理，例如合併成單一聲道音檔，以便交付給轉寫員。
action_items.evidence: ...taking the results of this meeting and putting it in some kind of decent form...

action_items.title: 對朗讀的數字數據進行切分和初步辨識
action_items.detail: 對會議中收集到的「朗讀數字」部分進行音檔切分，並執行初步的語音辨識，以評估數據品質和辨識效果。
action_items.evidence: And then do some segmenting and recognition - initial recognition...
I think that's probably the right way to do it... I just can't imagine that we're gonna get anything that much better from a commercial one.

action_items.detail: Design and build a cabinet to protect recording equipment. Also research purchasing or replacing preamps to resolve noise issues.
action_items.evidence: Well I can build a cabinet. The - the difficulty for this kind of project is the intellectual capital to design the cabinet.

history.change: Owner updated to me028 (Jim). Detail updated to reflect design/build task.

action_items.title: 解決數據儲存空間不足的問題
action_items.detail: 評估長期數據儲存需求，並採購額外的硬碟空間（例如 40-100 GB），同時整理現有伺服器空間。
action_items.evidence: ...we definitely need to go buy you know forty gig - fifty gig of drive - drive space.
What we're using right now is a tool, um, from this French group, called 'Transcriber' that seems to work very well.

action_items.title: 詢問 LDC 使用的轉錄工具
action_items.detail: 聯繫語言數據聯盟 (LDC) 的聯絡人，詢問他們內部實際使用的轉錄工具。
action_items.evidence: I could ask my contacts at the L_D_C what it is they actually use.

action_items.title: 收集並寄出會議記錄系統的查詢範例
action_items.detail: 記錄下未來可能會對會議內容提出的問題，作為查詢範例，並透過電子郵件寄給 Adam (me011)。
action_items.evidence: ...if you find yourself wondering what we talked about in the meeting, write down the sort of query you'd like to make.
So what we wanted to do was have Jane do basically one meeting's worth... to get an estimate of how long it would take... Ten times about.

action_items.title: 諮詢 Susan Ervin-Tripp 關於雇用學生進行轉錄的建議
action_items.detail: 向 Susan Ervin-Tripp 教授請教，了解雇用大學生或研究生進行大規模會議轉錄的可行性、成本與品質控管等相關建議。
action_items.evidence: I can ask Susan Ervin-Tripp what she would recommend on that.
I've looked a little bit into commercial transcription services... they were about thirty dollars an hour... if it's ten times it's three hundred dollars an hour.

action_items.detail: Order a copy of the Corpus of Spoken American English (CSAE) from the LDC to evaluate its data, transcription format, and potential usefulness for the current project.
action_items.evidence: O_K, why don't you go ahead and do that then Eric? / Alright, I'll do that.

action_items.detail: Talk to Liz to see if there are any transcription issues related to discourse that need to be marked in the transcripts.
action_items.evidence: ...maybe Jane should talk to Liz, to see if there are any transcription issues related to discourse that she needs to get marked.

action_items.detail: Build the circuit boards for the custom microphone jack boxes that will be installed under the tables.
action_items.evidence: Which is to say, uh, the neighborhood of a week to get the circuit board done.

action_items.detail: Set up a laptop (e.g., the borrowed I_RAM VAIO) with a wireless card to act as a control and monitoring user interface in the meeting room.
action_items.evidence: ...it's just a question of getting a laptop and a wireless modem. / I had actually earlier asked if I could borrow one of the cards... I think it won't be a problem.

method_changes.after: 採用類似 STM 的格式，每個語句(utterance)標記為單一發言者，但允許多個語句在時間上重疊。每個語句都需要有開始和結束的時間戳記。
method_changes.reason: 為了處理會議中常見的發言重疊與打斷情況，同時保留後續進行時間對齊(time alignment)所需的資訊。
method_changes.evidence: O_K. So that means that for each utterance, we'll need the time marks, the start and end of each utterance.

experiment_todos.description: 評估從「朗讀數字」任務中收集到的音檔品質，特別是不同麥克風（近場、遠場PZM）之間的差異。
experiment_todos.evidence: ...do some segmenting and recognition - initial recognition would be interesting to do.

experiment_todos.description: 分析 Dan 自製的前置放大器產生過多噪聲的原因，並評估是否可以修復或需要替換。
experiment_todos.evidence: I built this thing, it's - that's - it's very noisy... I probably know how to fix this.

experiment_todos.description: 根據本次24位元錄音的結果，分析有效的信號位元深度，並決定未來錄音是否可以降採樣至16位元以節省空間，同時要考慮PZM麥克風增益過低的問題。
experiment_todos.evidence: ...initially we should take up more space until we've analyzed this and get a better sense of it.

experiment_todos.description: Test if providing pre-segmented audio (with utterance boundaries already marked) significantly speeds up the manual transcription process compared to having the transcriber mark segments themselves.
experiment_todos.evidence: I could generate the segmentation and - and you could do the words, and time yourself on it. So. / That's good. I like that.
